blocks.t: **Objetivo de comunicação (C2):** eu consigo ler, ouvir, falar e escrever sobre participação política a partir de um e-mail a um representante, defendendo uma posição com clareza, tom firme e cortesia.

body: Esta aula treina **ler textos curtos e achar informação (IELTS Reading, TOEFL Reading)**.

blocks.t: Toque em 🔊, ouça e repita cada palavra. Depois tente adivinhar o sentido.

items: projeto de lei de financiamento escolar

blocks.subject: Please oppose Bill 214 on school funding
paras: I am writing as a **constituent** and a teacher of twenty years to **urge you to oppose** Bill 214. Although I **appreciate** its stated aim, the bill would **divert** funds from **under-resourced schools**, **widening** the very gap it claims to close.

**With respect**, I would ask you to **consider** an alternative: a **phased increase** tied to **measurable outcomes**. I **would welcome** the chance to **discuss** this in person, and I **enclose** the data **on which** my concern is based.
**Thank you for your time and service.** Yours sincerely, Hana Novak

blocks.body: Uma boa carta política tem **pedido claro na primeira frase**, **concessão**, **alternativa** e **dados**. Mantenha o tom **firme e cortês**.
*Urge you to oppose* ✓ (urge + objeto + to); não *urge you oppose* ✗.

items.s: I am writing as a ___ and a teacher. (constituent)
I ___ you to oppose the bill. (urge)
The bill would ___ funds from schools. (divert)
I ___ the data on which my concern is based. (enclose)

body: **Write to one’s representative.** — Escrever ao seu representante.
**Make one’s voice heard.** — Fazer a sua voz ser ouvida.
**Ask for the floor.** — Pedir a palavra.
**Lobby for.** — Fazer lobby por.
**Sign a petition.** — Assinar um abaixo-assinado.
**Take a position on.** — Posicionar-se sobre.
**With the greatest respect,…** — Com todo o respeito,…
**Yours faithfully.** — Atenciosamente (sem nome).
**At your earliest convenience.** — O quanto antes puder.
**In the public interest.** — No interesse público.
**Senator Rao’s office, how can I help?** — Gabinete do senador Rao, em que posso ajudar?
**I’m a constituent calling about Bill 214.** — Sou eleitora ligando sobre o projeto 214.
**Would you like to leave a message?** — Gostaria de deixar um recado?

items.label: Ajuste refinado de entonação
items.note: Ritmo e ênfase para nuances: o acento muda o sentido (He said she STOLE it × he said SHE stole it) e as pausas separam ideias técnicas densas.
words: I didn’t SAY he did it.
I didn’t say HE did it.
I didn’t say he DID it.

prompts.q: State your request in one sentence.
prompts.model: I urge you to oppose the bill.
Although I appreciate its aim, I cannot support the means.
I would ask you to consider a phased increase.

blocks.task: Write a 6-sentence letter to an elected representative about a local issue you care about, with a request, a concession and an alternative.
blocks.model: Dear Councillor Mbeki, I am writing as a resident of Pine Street to urge you to oppose the proposed bus-route cuts. Although I appreciate the need to save money, the cuts would isolate elderly residents. I would ask you to consider reducing frequency rather than eliminating the route. I enclose a petition with 300 signatures. I would welcome the chance to meet. Thank you for your time and service.

body: Treine esta habilidade com o formato de tarefas curtas das provas (TOEFL/IELTS).
Leia o enunciado primeiro e procure as palavras-chave.
Use exemplos reais da vida dos alunos e peça frases próprias.
Corrija o erro mais frequente da aula em grupo, sem expor o aluno.
Retome o conteúdo na aula seguinte com um exercício curto.
